leadText:
Volume 45 is the 45th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the third volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume three of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".
plainText:
Volume 45 is the 45th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the third volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's translation, this volume is published as volume three of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: Black & White".

==Blurb==
A precious fossil is stolen from the Nacrene Museum! Can Black track it down by…following its tracks? Then, mysterious Team Plasma is one step closer to bringing back a Legendary Pokémon. What are they up to? Probably no good!

Plus, will Gigi and Tep’s relationship survive…a major change?!

==Party changes==
===Additions===
No Pokémon are caught in this volume.

===Evolutions===
Black's "Tep" evolves into "Nite" in PS479.

==Gym battles==
 defeats the following Gym Leaders:

Lenora in PS474
Burgh in PS479

==Errors==
The chapters in the Japanese version of this volume are numbered incorrectly. While closes with PS471, this volume's chapters are numbered 471-478, while in reality these chapters are 472-479. They are all numbered incorrectly on both the title pages and on the table of contents.
